description.value: Fort Nelson Hotel is a hotel in Fort Nelson, a remote community in northeastern BC situated along the Alaska Highway. It serves as a significant stop for long-distance travellers in one of BC's most isolated northern corridors. Touring cyclists tackling the Alaska Highway or routes through the Northern Rockies will find this a key overnight option in an area with limited services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a security-threat interception page (redirecting to cf.miniroad.store, a flagged malicious domain) rather than actual hotel content, so this is effectively a FETCH FAILED situation and I must rely entirely on OSM tags. OSM tags confirm it is a hotel at 5100 50th Avenue North, Fort Nelson, with a phone number and internet_access=wlan; check_date 2025-06-28 indicates the record was recently verified as open. No cyclist-specific amenity information can be confirmed without website content.
concerns: Website appears to be compromised or hacked: the fetched page is a security-threat interception warning showing a redirect to cf.miniroad.store, a flagged malicious domain. No actual hotel content was retrievable. The website URL may need to be verified or updated.
All amenity details are unverifiable due to the inaccessible website; only OSM tags could be used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real hotel in Fort Nelson confirmed open as of OSM check_date 2025-06-28; a legitimate and valuable stop for cyclists on northern BC routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM record includes internet_access=wlan suggesting Wi-Fi is available, but this could not be confirmed through website content. Website should be investigated for compromise before directing cyclists to it.
